title: Needle in the config
briefing: A 60-line config hides one API key. Don't scroll — search.
tips: `grep WORD file` prints only the lines that contain WORD.
objective: Find the API key in ~/service.ini and print the line that contains it.
hints: You want only the line mentioning the key. grep filters to matching lines.
The key line contains 'api_key'. `grep api_key service.ini`.
explanation: `grep` is the fastest way to find a line in a file — or across many with -r. You'll reach for it more than any other command.
